name: Surron
description: Surron was a world located in the Surron sector of the Expansion Region. It was the homeworld of the Surronians, an insectoid species with a guild-based society. The Surronian were long-respected shipbuilders, renowned for their innovative starship designs. The Surron system hosted shipyards and Surron was the headquarters of the shipwright Surron StarTech.
